intuition: Repeated parent jumps can be composed into powers of two.

brute_force.approach: Follow the parent pointer once for every requested ancestor step.

optimal.approach: Precompute binary-lifting ancestors and combine entries for the set bits of k.
optimal.time: construction O(n log n), getKthAncestor O(log n)

edge_cases: A missing parent remains -1 through all higher jumps.
k equal to zero returns the queried node.
